text:
perf-bot: [ALERT] p99 tail latency up ~120ms on continuous-batcher (gpu-pool-3). Spike started ~1749998875. Suspect: kernel_selector + prefetch worker. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz/continuous-batcher

samira: saw the alert, starting a sampled profile. initial glance shows increased time in kernel_selector::choose_kernel and prefetch_stride loop. kv_cache hit-rate dropped ~15% concurrently.

samira: perf sampling snippet I ran:
```
sudo perf record -F 99 -p $(pgrep continuous-batcher) -g -- sleep 30
sudo perf script | ./stackcollapse-perf.pl | ./flamegraph.pl > flame.svg
```
link: https://perf.redwood/trace/abc123

jen: curious — did any kernel-selector change roll out in the last 24h? I remember an opt that prefers fused-kv kernel when prefetch_stride>2.

matt: yes, rolled #7821 ~6h ago, toggled prefetch_stride default from 1 -> 4 to favor packing. It seemed fine on staging.

diego: KV metrics show eviction spikes around the same time, kv_cache_size pressure up 30%. If prefetch is generating more prefixes we might be evicting hot entries and thrashing.

samira: agree. Plan: 1) quick revert of #7821 canary to prod 2) temporarily clamp PREFETCH_STRIDE=1 on gpu-pool-3 3) run 2-minute sampled profiles post-change and watch kv_hit_rate and p99.

jen: I'll open revert PR and a small config flag to clamp stride per-pool. Command to revert:
```
gh pr revert 7821 --repo redwood/runtime --body \"revert: revert prefetch-stride default, rolling back to 1 while we investigate\"
```

deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for gpu-pool-3 at 1749998950. Notifying on-call.

matt: also adding a temp admission throttle for noisy tenants: `--max-concurrent-requests=80` on the pool to reduce packing pressure.

samira: post-canary results: after clamping PREFETCH_STRIDE p99 dropped ~90ms and kv_hit_rate recovered. Flamegraph shows less time in prefetch loop, kernel_selector back to baseline.

diego: opening postmortem issue with profiling attachments and remediation items (cache tuning, metric alerting for prefetch-induced eviction). PRs: #7890 (revert), #7891 (per-pool clamp), #7892 (admission throttle).

samira: assigning follow-ups: samira -> sampled profiling + flamegraphs, jen -> revert PR + tests, diego -> kv cache telemetry alert, matt -> rollout throttle. :thumbsup:

matt: thanks — will keep watching for 1hr and then close the incident if stable.
